forest.title: Forest
forest.caption: Rolling grass hills and oak woods, with the grass tinted by the temperate climate.

steppe.title: Steppe
steppe.caption: A dry, open grass plain, yellower than the forest, with scattered dead trees.

steppe_desert.title: Steppe meets desert
steppe_desert.caption: Borders are slopes and ragged patches rather than lines: sand creeps into the dry grass.

savanna_desert.title: Savanna meets desert
savanna_desert.caption: The warm, dry edge where savanna grass gives way to dunes.

frozen.title: Frozen tundra
frozen.caption: Permafrost under snow, with sparse dead shrubs and leafless snags.

ocean_bay.title: Ocean
ocean_bay.caption: A sandy shore sloping into water with waves, foam and sun glitter.

desert.title: Desert
desert.caption: Dunes of sand over sandstone, with cacti and dead trees.

tundra.title: Frozen plain
tundra.caption: A wide, white tundra under a low horizon.

ragged_border.title: A ragged border
ragged_border.caption: A coherent noise breaks material lines into patches, never single columns.

steppe_tundra.title: Steppe meets tundra
steppe_tundra.caption: Dry grass fades into frozen ground, with a wide band between sand and snow.

savanna.title: Savanna
savanna.caption: Dry grassland with umbrella-crowned stone pines and wild cotton.

savanna_ground.title: Savanna, ground level
savanna_ground.caption: Cotton clumps and stone pines on the warm, dry plain.

pack_ice.title: Pack ice
pack_ice.caption: In cold seas the water freezes into a walkable sheet, broken into floes.

pack_ice_low.title: Pack ice, ground level
pack_ice_low.caption: Icebergs drift where the sea is just cold enough.

origin_valley.title: The spawn valley
origin_valley.caption: Near the spawn the land is kept calm: gentle hills and a wide valley.

forest_highland.title: Highlands
forest_highland.caption: A continent-scale lift raises some regions into highlands.

range_along.title: A mountain range
range_along.caption: Ranges are chains hundreds of blocks long, found only inside highlands.

range_across.title: Across a range
range_across.caption: Looking across a range, with ridges and valleys running along it.

arid_plateau.title: An arid plateau
arid_plateau.caption: In dry land a highland becomes a lifted plateau instead of broken country.

massif.title: A massif
massif.caption: Rare massifs rise to an absolute summit with a pointed, spurred body.

massif_summit.title: A massif summit
massif_summit.caption: The crown of a massif, with snow even in a warm biome.

lone_peak.title: A lone peak
lone_peak.caption: A single peak standing on flat ground.

island.title: An island
island.caption: Islands rise out of deep water, ringed by sand.

island_beach.title: An island beach
island_beach.caption: The shore of an island with its beach.

great_lake_elevated.title: A great lake
great_lake_elevated.caption: Rare, lobed lakes a few hundred blocks across with islands and shores of their own. In the cold they freeze like any water.

great_lake_island.title: A lake island
great_lake_island.caption: A great lake with an island in its main lobe.

hell_layer0.title: Hell
hell_layer0.caption: Right under the barrier: a lava-lit cavern under a red haze.

hell_layer1.title: The second layer
hell_layer1.caption: Every layer is a cavern pocket over an unbroken slab of hellrock, and deeper ones are more open.

hell_ashlands.title: Ashlands
hell_ashlands.caption: Ash over cinder soil, scorched walls, ember blooms and charred trees.

hell_magma.title: Magma Caverns
hell_magma.caption: Basalt and magma floors with lava pools.

hell_fungal.title: Fungal Grove
hell_fungal.caption: Glowing teal fungi, glow ferns, thick vines and fungal trees.

sky_cloud_patches.title: Solid clouds
sky_cloud_patches.caption: Cloud slabs above every mountain that catch a fall.

sky_cloud_sea.title: The cloud sea
sky_cloud_sea.caption: A thick sea of solid cloud under the islands, with holes down to the world.

sky_zone.title: Islands in the sky
sky_zone.caption: Islands float everywhere in the band and crowd closer together inside zones.

sky_island.title: A floating island
sky_island.caption: Domed grass tops over a tapering, stalactite-hung underside.

sky_meadow.title: Meadow island
sky_meadow.caption: Grass over dirt over stone, with tall grass, flowers and broad sky oaks.

sky_meadow_above.title: A meadow from above
sky_meadow_above.caption: Looking down on a meadow island.

sky_frost.title: Frost highland island
sky_frost.caption: Frosted turf over permafrost, with crystal outcrops and glowing crystal trees.

sky_frost_above.title: A frost island from above
sky_frost_above.caption: Looking down on a frost highland island.

waystone_surface.title: A surface waystone
waystone_surface.caption: An open pavilion with a lantern over the waystone, a short walk from a ruined hall.

waystone_underground.title: An underground waystone
waystone_underground.caption: A sealed, lamp-lit crypt with the waystone on a dais. You dig in to reach it.

waystone_sky.title: A sky waystone
waystone_sky.caption: A frost-stone plaza under a crystal-keyed arch, on the island of a sky ruin.

waystone_hell.title: A hell waystone
waystone_hell.caption: A basalt ring crowned with ember crystal, in the same hell layer as its ruin.

aurora.title: The aurora
aurora.caption: Slow green and violet curtains in the night sky of cold lands.

night_sky.title: Stars
night_sky.caption: The star field turns once a day; there is no aurora over the temperate lands.

moon.title: The moon
moon.caption: The moon goes through phases, and at night it is the world’s key light.
